```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

# Problem 1

The important variables are `r names(penguins)`

The penguin species includes `r unique(penguins$species)`.

The islands are `r unique(penguins$island)`.

The recorded sex values are `r unique(penguins$sex)`.

The observation years are `r unique(penguins$year)`

The recorded sex values are `r unique(penguins$sex)`.

This penguins dataset cotains `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables.

The mean flipper length is `r mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)` mm

```{r scatterplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm,
                     y=flipper_length_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE)
ggsave("penguin_scatterpoint.png")
```
